ROBLOX – MILLIONS OF GAMES ACROSS EVERY GENRE. PLAY FREE.
Roblox is home to every kind of game, for every kind of player. Compete in high-octane racing games, battle it out in hardcore tactical shooters, or put your survival skills to the test in unpredictable environments. Embark on an epic adventure in immersive RPGs, build massive empires in tycoons, or dive into horror, anime, and sports games with friends worldwide.
Roblox is constantly evolving, with unique experiences and ambitious, high-fidelity games built by a global community including professional studios, indie teams, and solo creators. There’s always something new to discover every day.
Start playing some of the most popular games on Roblox today, including Dress to Impress, RIVALS, Steal a Brainrot, Brookhaven RP, Adopt Me! and more.
WHAT YOU CAN DO ON ROBLOX
PLAY ONLINE MULTIPLAYER GAMES
Discover deep role-playing games, immersive simulators, action-packed adventures, and more
Explore trending experiences and new games daily
Compete in massive multiplayer battles, run your own digital business, or embark on epic quests
Games may contain optional in-game purchases, including lootboxes and other items
CREATE YOUR OWN AVATAR
Customize your avatar with detailed clothing, accessories, and dynamic hairstyles
Discover thousands of user-created 3D avatar items in the Marketplace
Express yourself with unique emotes, and fashion
CHAT, COMPETE, AND EXPLORE TOGETHER—ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
Hang out and play with friends in cross-platform multiplayer games on mobile, tablet, PC, console, and VR headsets
Join a Party and jump into competitive or social experiences together
Age-verified users can communicate in real-time via voice chat or text
CREATE, PLAY, AND SHARE ON ROBLOX
Design high-fidelity games and virtual spaces using the Roblox Studio engine on Windows or Mac
Publish your experiences and empower yourself as a creator in a massive global community
Dive into immersive 3D multiplayer games and safe, inclusive environments designed for users of all ages
Enjoy endless new content added daily and share your creations with millions of players
ELEVATE YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH ROBLOX PLUS
Get up to 20% discounts on in-game items, enjoy fee-free Robux transfers, and receive a distinct profile badge
Host free, unlimited private servers for your friends
Publish, trade, and resell your own custom avatar creations on the Marketplace
INDUSTRY-LEADING SAFETY, PRIVACY, AND CIVILITY
Advanced content filtering and age-appropriate moderation
Access age-verified spaces and manage your privacy with Roblox Kids and Select Accounts
Clear community guidelines promoting respectful interactions
Dedicated trust & safety teams working around the clock

Close friends suggestion!!
Hello Roblox, I just wanted to start off by saying that this game has made my entire childhood. I’ve been playing this game for a very long time. It has made me the person who I am right now. Other than a couple of other flaws that this game may have it’s a really good game, and I suggest anybody to play it who is of age. Anyway, I had a suggestion where there should be this thing called“close friends.” It’s kind of like an Instagram thing where you’re able to add people to your close friends so only a certain amount of people can post something that you’ve posted for close friends. I was thinking that should also be something for Roblox where you can add people to your close friends, and if you go into settings and press, close friends, only those certain people that you chose can see what game you’re in. Experience, it’s sometimes annoying when I’m playing a certain game and I have some friends that I don’t mind seeing when I’m playing, but others I do mind. I feel like it would be a good opportunity for people to feel comfortable with to see what they’re playing with but also being able to choose who can see. I think it’s annoying when you have 100+ friends and you can’t really change who can see what you’re playing. it would be if you had someone added to your close friends it would have a green circle surrounding their profile and star that says close friends. That’s all, thank you so much and I hope this gets to you. :)❤️

This is great! I have a few suggestions that might make it even better!
Roblox is so amazing. It’s perfect for playing with friends and there’s NO WAY you’ll get bored. There are so many amazing games made by other Roblox players. Ok, now for suggestions. Robux on here is a bit pricey, and the math doesn’t add up correctly. You can spend 50 dollars for 4,500 and pay 100 dollars for 10,000. But, if you buy the 50 dollar one twice, which adds up to spending the same amount of money as buying the 10,000 Robux, you only get 9,000 instead of 10,000. But back to Robux being pricey. 100 dollars for 10,000 Robux is a bit much. You should probably downgrade quite a lot, say maybe 1/2 or 3/4 that price. Also, I have a small suggestion for Roblox chat and how you can get banned. Getting banned for saying something like “pog” or “I’m not a furry” is not a great reason to be banned. Also, in text chat, could you make it a little less restricted? When I say this, I mean instead of making the entire thing tags, maybe just the word the filter doesn’t like. The filter can be annoying when you are in a role-play and you or the other player is trying to say something, and then it’s just tags. I really, really suggest making the filter less annoying. And lastly, this is more so linked to Roblox Studio, could you make it so that those on mobile can create games and so that inside of games like please donate we can get robux from other people? Alright. That’s all I have, thank you for reading.

This game is the best!
I honestly L O V E Roblox! I have had it for years, I got hacked once, and another acc just stopped working, but that was in the past. I love making my character and playing with friends, but when you buy something and it stops selling or something (it’s n/a) I wish that you could get a robux refund!!! Also I wish you could report a recent buy of something because once I bought a “fake headless” and it turned out to be just a donation which was annoying. Also I kinda of am annoyed that Roblox will stop selling things on the market that are super popular, so there’s is just no point in even waiting all they way to Halloween every year, just to spend it all on one thing. Another thing, one of my friends joined a long time ago, she was like 6 I’m pretty sure, I joined in like 2019 when I was like 8 or so, and she set it up herself so she put her birthday, then the year that it was currently. Right now on her account it says she is about 7 or something. I have voice chat, and she is soooo jealous because she just isn’t able to change her age, I tried to help her too but when we sent a report and stuff it just said that if your age is under 13 you cannot change it period. Her mom tried to help and give permission but it said you can. not. change it! What if someone made a mistake when they were little like her? Then what do you do? Wait until you don’t even play the game anymore? Roblox usually never responds to these I know that, but please read this if you can.
